title: bee close prints a token-usage section (sessions + subagents + total)
description: On a GREEN close in close_handler (packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/drivers/close.rs, summary assembly around lines 2384-2460): collect session ids = every .bee/sessions/*.json whose record has lane == <closing feature>, plus the calling session id (resolve like resolve_release_session_id in verbs/state_group/sessions.rs: BEE_SESSION_ID else CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID), deduped. For each record with a transcript_path that exists on disk, call rollup_transcript (packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/hooks/session_close/perf.rs:383 — remove its #[allow(dead_code)]) and sum: main tokens from Rollup.models, subagent tokens from Rollup.subagent_models (each model entry carries input/output/cache_write/cache_read/new/cached/total). Records without a readable transcript are skipped and counted. Push ONE summary line into the close output lines, e.g. usage: 2 session(s) - 1.4M tokens (main 1.1M, subagents 0.3M; new 0.5M, cached 0.9M), skipping the line entirely when no transcript was readable; format token counts with a small k/M helper (reuse one if it exists). Insert a usage object into the JSON result: {sessions, skipped, main: {new, cached, total}, subagents: {new, cached, total}, total: {new, cached, total}}. Tests: unit tests beside the new code — build a temp root with .bee/sessions/<id>.json records (one bound to the feature with a transcript fixture containing assistant events with message.usage fields and a subagents/<n>.jsonl sidecar, one with a missing transcript) and assert the summed numbers, the skipped count, and that a feature with zero readable transcripts emits no usage line. Follow existing test style in close.rs/perf.rs.
acceptance: bee close (green path) emits a usage line and a usage JSON object covering all sessions bound to the feature plus the calling session, subagent tokens included; unreadable transcripts are skipped and counted; scoped cargo tests green.
action: Add a token-usage section to bee close: sum main + subagent tokens per feature-bound session via rollup_transcript, emit one summary line and a usage JSON object, with tests
judge_obligation_ack: perf.rs touch only removes #[allow(dead_code)] on rollup_transcript; no guard logic changes
